episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Tensions rise as the search for suspects begins. Michelle Calderone pumps the brakes on her personal life. Dave Gudsen gets creative.

episodes.title: Your Happy Makes Me Sad
episodes.summary: Seemingly stalled, Gudsen and Calderone consider a new lead. Chaos ensues on a side mission. Freddy Fasano rethinks his future.

episodes.title: Weird Milk
episodes.summary: Calderone charts her own course for answers. Gudsen pitches a new path for their partnership. Freddy heads to Coop's headquarters.

episodes.title: Strawberry
episodes.summary: Gudsen sheds light on his dark past. Calderone digs even deeper. Freddy starts to spiral.

episodes.title: Size Matters
episodes.summary: While Gudsen heads out of town for a conference, Calderone tries to track down his old partner. Freddy seeks revenge.

episodes.title: Manhood
episodes.summary: Esposito and Calderone urge Harvey to take action. A fully rogue Freddy reaches out to an ally.

episodes.title: Whitewashed Tombs
episodes.summary: On the heels of heartache, Calderone clocks in for a covert mission. Gudsen navigates new-found glory—and an unexpected confrontation.

episodes.title: Mercy
episodes.summary: Gudsen flips the script. Harvey grapples with regret. Calderone is forced to confront her past.

episodes.title: Mirror Mirror
episodes.summary: Season finale. A desperate Calderone calls in a favour. Gudsen scrambles for control. A massive blaze stokes a make-or-break showdown.
